_comment: Generated by `cargo xtask gen-stubs` from crates/mvm-sdk/src/env.rs.
This is a JSON instance document, NOT a JSON Schema — it carries
values, and the per-language bindings are rendered from it by
xtask/src/gen_sdk_surface.rs rather than by the schema generators.
Do not edit by hand; `cargo xtask check-stubs` fails on drift.
A name lists a surface only when that surface actually reads it.

vars.doc: Selects the SDK's execution mode (for example `live` or `record`).
vars.name: MVM_SDK_MODE

vars.doc: Carries an explicitly selected security profile from `mvmctl run` into the machine a live-mode `Sandbox` boots through the host library.
vars.name: MVM_SDK_RUN_PROFILE

vars.doc: When set, the SDK writes its wire-shape recording JSON to this path on exit, so a caller need not parse stdout.
vars.name: MVM_SDK_OUT_PATH

vars.doc: Names the `libmvm_hostlib` file the SDKs load in-process. Consulted before any other location; `mvmctl run --mode live` sets it to the library installed beside itself, so a script it runs drives the same build.
vars.name: MVM_HOSTLIB_PATH
